subject: Request to move our meeting time
text: Could we move our Friday meeting to 4:15 p.m.? The building parking area closes at 4:30 for an inspection, and I need enough time to leave campus before the bus depot changes routes. The current 4:00 slot would still work for me if moving it creates difficulty, though I would need to arrange another way home. I can attend at the original time only if the inspection is canceled.
